title.en: Magnetic Field Lines of a Bar Magnet
title.hi: छड़ चुंबक की चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएँ

description.en: Magnetic field lines starting from the North pole and ending at the South pole.
description.hi: उत्तरी ध्रुव से शुरू होकर दक्षिणी ध्रुव पर समाप्त होने वाली चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएँ।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(200, 150)">
    <!-- Field Lines Top -->
    <path d="M -40 -20 C -60 -100, 60 -100, 40 -20" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M -30 -20 C -40 -60, 40 -60, 30 -20" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M -40 -20 C -100 -150, 100 -150, 40 -20" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Field Lines Bottom -->
    <path d="M -40 20 C -60 100, 60 100, 40 20" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M -30 20 C -40 60, 40 60, 30 20" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M -40 20 C -100 150, 100 150, 40 20" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Bar Magnet -->
    <rect x="-50" y="-20" width="50" height="40" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <rect x="0" y="-20" width="50" height="40" fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <text x="-25" y="6" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">N</text>
    <text x="25" y="6" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">S</text>
  </g>
</svg>
